transitous.purpose: Forward geocoding and autocomplete for transit stops and addresses
transitous.dataReceived: Matches with type (STOP/ADDRESS/PLACE), name, coordinates, transport modes, score

motis.purpose: Forward and reverse geocoding via self-hosted MOTIS instance
motis.dataSent: Search query text or coordinates (latitude, longitude), language
motis.dataReceived: Matches with type, name, coordinates, street, house number, transport modes
